title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Chris Boswell makes two FGs in Week 1
items.desc: Chris Boswell made two of his three field-goal tries while adding two extra points in a 20-13 win over the Falcons in Week 1.
items.impact: Boswell made field goals from 43 and 28 yards out in the win. The veteran kicker will now get ready to take on the Patriots in Week 2.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Pat Freiermuth finds the end zone in Week 1 win
items.desc: Pat Freiermuth caught all five of his targets for 46 yards and a touchdown in a 20-13 win over the Falcons in Week 1.
items.impact: Freiermuth kicked off the season with a promising outing in the win over Atlanta. He hauled in Aaron Rodgers' lone touchdown pass on a six-yard catch in the second quarter while tying for second on the team in receptions. Freiermuth will settle in as a TE2 in fantasy heading into a Week 2 matchup against the Patriots.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. goes for 58 yards in Week 1
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. caught all three of his targets for 58 yards in a 20-13 win over the Falcons in Week 1.
items.impact: Pittman led the Steelers in receiving despite only seeing three targets. It was a slightly concerning Pittsburgh debut for the veteran, as DK Metcalf easily dominated in the target category, drawing 10. Pittman will be a fantasy flex option heading into Week 2 against the Patriots but should be on the bench if there are better starting options available.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: DK Metcalf leads Steelers with 10 targets in Week 1
items.desc: DK Metcalf caught four of his 10 targets for 40 yards in a 20-13 win over the Falcons in Week 1.
items.impact: Metcalf didn't do much damage but his usage was encouraging as he easily led the Steelers in targets while newcomer Michael Pittman Jr. saw just three looks from Aaron Rodgers. Metcalf will be a high-end WR3 in fantasy heading into Week 2 against the Patriots.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Rico Dowdle quiet in Week 1 win
items.desc: Rico Dowdle carried the ball eight times for 15 yards and caught two of his five targets for six yards in a 20-13 win over the Falcons in Week 1.
items.impact: Dowdle and Jaylen Warren split the backfield with Warren racking up more all-purpose yards (73 to 21) and seeing five more touches. Dowdle will continue to have fantasy value as he's proven in past years that he can be a difference-maker, but he should be on fantasy benches heading into a Week 2 matchup against the Patriots.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Jaylen Warren leads Pittsburgh backfield in Week 1
items.desc: Jaylen Warren carried the ball 10 times for 46 yards while catching five of his six targets for 27 yards and losing a fumble in a 20-13 win over the Falcons in Week 1.
items.impact: Warren and Rico Dowdle split first-team reps in the preseason, but it was Warren who emerged with the better game in Week 1, out-touching Dowdle 15 to 10 and out-gaining him 73 to 21. Warren will be a flex option for fantasy purposes heading into Week 2 against the Patriots.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Aaron Rodgers throws for 221 yards, one TD in Week 1 win
items.desc: Aaron Rodgers completed 24 of his 40 passes for 221 yards and a touchdown in a 20-13 win over the Falcons in Week 1.
items.impact: Rodgers led the Steelers to a win in Week 1 with a steady yet unspectacular performance. Pittsburgh only managed 264 yards of total offense in the win but it was enough to defeat the Cooper Rush-led Falcons. Rodgers' lone touchdown pass went to Pat Freiermuth on a six-yard catch in the second quarter. Rodgers will be a low-end QB2 in fantasy heading into Week 2 against the Patriots.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Falcons D/ST picks up two sacks in Week 1
items.desc: The Falcons D/ST allowed 20 points while picking up two sacks and forcing a turnover in a 20-13 loss to the Steelers in Week 1.
items.impact: Atlanta's defense turned in a solid effort, limiting the Steelers to 264 yards of total offense in the loss. They recovered a Jaylen Warren fumble in the game, while Za'Darius Smith notched both of the team's sacks. The Falcons will now take on a Panthers defense that allowed 59 points to the Bears in Week 1.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Nick Folk misses two FGs in Week 1
items.desc: Nick Folk hit two of his four field-goal attempts and added an extra point in a 20-13 loss to the Steelers in Week 1.
items.impact: Folk hit from 51 and 43 yards out in the close loss. It was a disappointing Falcons debut for the long-time NFL kicker who missed just one of 29 field-goal tries for the Jets in 2025. He will look to bounce back against the Panthers in Week 2.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Kyle Pitts Sr. held without a catch in Week 1
items.desc: Kyle Pitts Sr. failed to catch his lone target in a 20-13 loss to the Steelers in Week 1.
items.impact: It was a rough day for the Atlanta passing attack as third-string QB Cooper Rush only passed for 143 yards. Pitts will hope to bounce back in Week 2 against the Panthers, although he will be tough to trust in fantasy as long as Rush is under center.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Drake London held to two catches in Week 1 loss
items.desc: Drake London caught two of his four targets for 29 yards in a 20-13 loss to the Steelers in Week 1. He also gained six yards on his lone carry in the game.
items.impact: London was quiet in the close loss, although his 29 receiving yards were good enough for him to finish second on the Falcons in that category. The Falcons were forced to play Cooper Rush, their third-string QB, thanks to injuries, so London should bounce back once either Tua Tagovailoa or Michael Penix is ready to return to the field. London sets up as a low-end WR1 heading into Week 2 against Carolina.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Brian Robinson Jr. runs for 31 yards in Week 1
items.desc: Brian Robinson Jr. carried the ball nine times for 31 yards in a 20-13 loss to the Steelers in Week 1.
items.impact: Robinson mixed in as the backup behind Bijan Robinson in the close loss. The veteran running back will continue to see some work as a breather back moving forward but he won't have much fantasy value outside of being a handcuff option. He will take on the Panthers in Week 2.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Bijan Robinson hauls in touchdown catch in Week 1
items.desc: Bijan Robinson carried the ball 21 times for 83 yards and caught eight of his 10 targets for 90 yards and a touchdown in a 20-13 loss to the Steelers in Week 1.
items.impact: Robinson was basically the entire offense for the Falcons in the close loss to Pittsburgh. He scored the team's only touchdown on a 23-yard catch at the end of the first quarter. It was an excellent start to the season for the star running back, who will slot in as a high-end RB1 in fantasy heading into a Week 2 matchup against the Panthers.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Cooper Rush throws one TD, two INTs in Week 1
items.desc: Cooper Rush completed 12 of his 22 passes for 143 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions in a 20-13 loss to the Steelers in Week 1.
items.impact: Rush was pressed into action with both Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) and Michael Penix (knee) dealing with injuries. The veteran signal-caller struggled to move the ball against Pittsburgh's defense in the loss. Rush's lone touchdown pass went to Bijan Robinson for a 23-yard score in the first quarter. Rush could be in line to start again in Week 2 against the Panthers if Tagovailoa isn't ready to play.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Vikings D/ST picks it up late Sunday
items.desc: The Vikings D/ST allowed 22 points on 419 total yards with one interception, one fumble recovery and four sacks on Sunday against the Packers.
items.impact: Minnesota struggled in the first half defensively, but limited Green Bay to just three points in the second half where they out-scored the Packers 29-3. They'll be tough to trust next week against the Bears.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Reichard connects on lone field goal Sunday
items.desc: Will Reichard made his lone field goal attempt and all four extra points on Sunday.
items.impact: Reichard made his field goal from 38 yards out. He remains a fairly reliable option for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: T.J. Hockenson hauls in touchdown Sunday
items.desc: T.J. Hockenson caught 4-of-5 targets for 36 yards in the Vikings 39-22 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Hockenson caught one of the three touchdowns thrown by Carson Wentz. He could be on the TE1 radar in a favorable matchup next week against the Bears.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jauan Jennings does not catch pass Sunday
items.desc: Jauan Jennings did not catch his lone target in the Vikings 39-22 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Jennings remains off the fantasy radar for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Addison fails to catch pass Sunday
items.desc: Jordan Addison did not catch either of his two targets in the Vikings 39-22 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Justin Jefferson dominated the targets after Carson Wentz took over behind center. Addison will be in the WR3/WR4 mix heading into Week 2 against a vulnerable Bears defense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Justin Jefferson scores two touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: Justin Jefferson caught 8-of-9 targets for 92 yards and two touchdowns in the Vikings 39-22 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Despite Kyler Murray leaving in the first quarter with a concussion, Jefferson was still able to produce in a big way with Carson Wentz. He remains a locked and loaded high-end WR1.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. finds the end zone Sunday
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. ran for 40 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries in the Vikings 39-22 win over the Packers. He did not catch his lone target.
items.impact: Jones was the 1B in the Vikings backfield behind Jordan Mason to open the season. He'll be a touchdown dependent RB2/flex play most weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Mason sees 15 carries Sunday
items.desc: Jordan Mason ran for 59 yards and a touchdown on 15 carries in the Vikings 39-22 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Mason led the way in the Vikings backfield as both he and Aaron Jones saw double-digit carries. He will be in the low-end RB2 conversation next week against the Bears.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carson Wentz tosses three touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: Carson Wentz completed 12-of-19 passes for 133 yards and three touchdowns in the Vikings 39-22 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Wentz entered the game in the first quarter after Kyler Murray exited with a concussion and was ruled out. He connected twice with Justin Jefferson and once with TJ Hockenson in the end zone. He could be in the QB2 conversation next week in 2-QB and superflex leagues against the Bears.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Packers D/ST totals three sacks Sunday
items.desc: The Packers D/ST allowed 39 points on 239 total yards with three sacks and one interception.
items.impact: Green Bay held its own early despite still being without Micah Parsons. The Packers draw Geno Smith and the Jets next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey Smack nails two deep field goals Sunday
items.desc: Trey Smack went 3-for-3 on field goal attempts and 1-for-2 on extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Smack nailed field goals from 59, 43 and 26 yards out. The Packers have found a kicker they can rely on.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tucker Kraft totals 65 yards Sunday
items.desc: Tucker Kraft caught 3-of-6 targets for 65 yards in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings.
items.impact: Kraft was playing in his first game back from his torn ACL. He was on a snap count in his first game back. He remains a TE1 heading into next week against the Jets.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jayden Reed quiet Sunday
items.desc: Jayden Reed caught 3-of-7 targets for 20 yards in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings.
items.impact: The seven targets were encouraging, but Reed was not anywhere near as productive as Christian Watson and Matthew Golden to open the season. He is a WR4/WR5 heading into Week 2.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matthew Golden totals 95 yards Sunday
items.desc: Matthew Golden caught 6-of-12 targets for 95 yards in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings.
items.impact: After a lost rookie season, Golden opened this year leading Green Bay receivers in targets on Sunday. He is in the WR3/WR4 mix heading into Week 2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Watson scores two touchdowns in big day Sunday
items.desc: Christian Watson caught 6-of-8 targets for 147 yards and two touchdowns in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings on Sunday.
items.impact: Watson exploded for an 81-yard catch and run score early. He was later found in the end zone again by Jordan Love. He will be an upside WR2 next week against the Jets.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Brooks sees seven carries Sunday
items.desc: Chris Brooks ran for 29 yards on seven carries in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings on Sunday. He did not catch his lone target.
items.impact: Brooks was the RB2 for Green Bay to open the season behind MarShawn Lloyd. He remains off the fantasy radar for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: MarShawn Lloyd sees 13 carries Sunday
items.desc: MarShawn Lloyd ran for 37 yards on 13 carries in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings. He did not catch his lone target.
items.impact: Lloyd was the lead back in the Packers backfield without Josh Jacobs. He was very inefficient as he averaged less than three yards per carry. He'll be a flex play next week against the Jets.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Love throws for 387 yards Sunday
items.desc: Jordan Love completed 21-of-42 passes for 387 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings.
items.impact: Love tossed both touchdowns to Christian Watson as those two connected all afternoon. He did lose a fumble as the struggles began in the second half against the Vikings defense. He will face the Jets next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bengals D/ST forces four fumbles Sunday
items.desc: The Bengals D/ST allowed 20 points on 282 total yards with four sacks and four fumble recoveries on Sunday against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: The Bengals defense forced three fumbles of Baker Mayfield alone on Sunday and one on Bucky Irving. They will face CJ Stroud and the Texans in Week 2.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Evan McPherson connects on seven kicks Sunday
items.desc: Evan McPherson made 4-of-4 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: McPherson connected on field goals from 20, 55, 58 and 32 yards out. He should remain a fairly reliable weekly play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Gesicki explodes to open season
items.desc: Mike Gesicki caught 5-of-7 targets for 78 yards with a touchdown in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: While Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins were fairly quiet on Sunday, it was Gesicki who led the team in receiving. Despite his big Week 1 performance, he still isn't a reliable weekly start yet.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrei Iosivas catches two passes Sunday
items.desc: Andrei Iosivas caught 2-of-3 targets for 12 yards in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: If you were told before Sunday that Iosivas was going to match Ja'Marr Chase in production, you likely would have expected a lot more. Iosivas remains off the fantasy radar as long as Chase and Tee Higgins are on the field.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tee Higgins totals 59 yards Sunday
items.desc: Tee Higgins caught 3-of-6 targets for 59 yards in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: It could have been worse. You could have Ja'Marr Chase catching two passes for 12 yards. It wasn't the most inspiring start to the season for Higgins, but he still had a couple of big catches. He'll remain an upside WR2 heading into Week 2 against the Texans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase very quiet to open season
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase caught 2-of-4 targets for 12 yards in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: It was a Week 1 to forget for Chase fantasy managers to say the least. There shouldn't be too much of concern after one week, though he draws an even tougher matchup in Week 2 against the Texans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Samaje Perine totals eight touches Sunday
items.desc: Samaje Perine ran for 20 yards on five carries in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers. He also caught 3-of-3 targets for 30 yards receiving.
items.impact: Perine was out-touched 21-8 by Chase Brown. He remains off the fantasy radar as long as Brown is healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chase Brown finds the end zone Sunday
items.desc: Chase Brown ran for 56 yards and a touchdown on 16 carries in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers. He also caught 5-of-6 targets for 22 yards receiving.
items.impact: Brown did not have the most efficient afternoon, but it still got the job done for fantasy managers. He draws a tougher matchup in Week 2 against the Texans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joe Burrow not at best Sunday
items.desc: Joe Burrow completed 25-of-35 passes for 254 yards with one touchdown and one interception in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
items.impact: While Cincinnati won the game, Burrow did not have the most inspiring of performances for fantasy managers. That included a pick-six. He will face the Texans defense in Week 2.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Buccaneers D/ST put in tough spot Sunday
items.desc: The Buccaneers D/ST allowed 26 points on 351 total yards with one interception and one sack on Sunday against the Bengals.
items.impact: Cincinnati scored 33 points, but one of them was off a fumble by Baker Mayfield returned for a touchdown. The Bengals also scored 17 other points off Bucs fumbles. The Bucs will be on the streaming radar in Week 2 against the Browns.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chase McLaughlin connects on five kicks Sunday
items.desc: Chase McLaughlin made 2-of-2 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: McLaughlin connected on field goals from 34 and 51 yards out. He should remain a steady option for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cade Otton quiet Sunday
items.desc: Cade Otton caught 3-for-5 targets for 26 yards in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
items.impact: Otton was third on the team in targets, but he was unable to turn it into much production. He remains a TE2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ted Hurst III catches three passes Sunday
items.desc: Ted Hurst III caught 3-of-3 targets for 36 yards in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss on Sunday against the Bengals.
items.impact: Hurst saw more opportunity as the WR3 with Jalen McMillan sidelined and he was able to flash. He'll still remain off the fantasy radar heading into Week 2.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Godwin Jr. hauls in four passes Sunday
items.desc: Chris Godwin Jr. caught 4-of-4 targets for 40 yards in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
items.impact: Godwin totaled 30 of his 40 yards on one reception. The Bucs offense was unable to get in sync with four lost fumbles. He'll remain a WR3 heading into Week 2 against the Browns.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Emeka Egbuka totals 63 yards Sunday
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka caught 5-of-6 targets for 63 yards in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
items.impact: Egbuka entered Sunday fully healthy after coming off a toe injury. He got off to a strong start in the first half, but he was not targeted in the second half despite the Bucs trailing. He remains a WR2 heading into Week 2.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenny Gainwell uninvolved Sunday
items.desc: Kenny Gainwell ran for 15 yards on five carries in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday. He also caught his line target for three yards receiving.
items.impact: This felt like the perfect time for Gainwell to make an impact with Tampa Bay falling behind 21-3 early, but it was Bucky Irving in the passing game out of the backfield who caught seven passes. Gainwell is a risky flex play for now in PPR leagues until we see him more involved.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bucky Irving active in passing game Sunday
items.desc: Bucky Irving ran for 45 yards and a touchdown on eight carries in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday. He also caught 7-of-7 targets for 48 yards receiving.
items.impact: Irving took advantage of the gamescript in the passing game with Tampa Bay falling behind 21-3 early. He also lost a fumble, but otherwise performed well. He will be an RB2 play next week against the Browns.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baker Mayfield loses three fumbles Sunday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield completed 23-of-28 passes for 216 yards in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
items.impact: Mayfield did not throw a touchdown or interception, but he did lose three fumbles. He was able to run for 30 yards and a touchdown, but struggled through the air and with ball security. He was playing his first game since landing a three-year extension. He'll look to bounce back against the Browns next week.
